nodes.name: job_reporter
nodes.input:
Based on the web search and verification of newly posted remote Python developer jobs, here is a verified list with job details and working links:

1. **Senior Python Developer (Remote)**  
   - **Company:** Joblet-AI  
   - **Location:** Remote (based in Canada)  
   - **Details:** Full-time contractor role supporting LLM development; 3+ years of Python experience required, 20–40 hrs/week with overlap with PST.  
   - **Link:** https://ca.linkedin.com/jobs/view/senior-python-developer-remote-at-joblet-ai-4490619120  

2. **Python + Django Senior Developer (Remote)**  
   - **Company:** BairesDev  
   - **Location:** Remote (Peru)  
   - **Details:** Lead complex projects using Python and Django; 4+ years of experience, advanced English required, fully remote with flexible hours.  
   - **Link:** https://pe.linkedin.com/jobs/view/python-%2B-django-senior-developer-remote-work-at-bairesdev-4486513048  

3. **SAS/Python Developer (Contract/FTE, Remote)**  
   - **Company:** Adastra  
   - **Location:** Markham, Ontario (Remote across Canada/USA)  
   - **Details:** Migrate legacy SAS workloads to Python; intermediate–senior experience required, proficiency in both SAS and Python, 100% remote.  
   - **Link:** https://ca.linkedin.com/jobs/view/sas-python-developer-contract-fte-remote-at-adastra-4483268903  

4. **Python Backend Developer (FastAPI & MongoDB) – Remote**  
   - **Company:** BairesDev  
   - **Location:** Lima, Peru (Remote)  
   - **Details:** Build health-data pipeline backend with async Python/FastAPI and MongoDB; 5+ years experience required, advanced English.  
   - **Link:** https://pe.linkedin.com/jobs/view/python-backend-developer-fastapi-mongodb-remote-work-ref%23308709-at-bairesdev-4487026203  

Let me know if you’d like further filtering (e.g., salary, timezone) or real-time alerts.
